answer.answer: defrost.py:642 summary(): duty_counts > 0 -> >= 0, so every bucket reports a measured duty, even with no duty samples. Should fail: a DefrostDerate.summary() test on a fresh learner asserting no measured-duty field in uncounted buckets (the diagnostics/attribute it feeds).

inputs_tried: null: one counted duty at 3 C / 85 %

should_fail: tests/features.py (its traced baseline executes defrost.py:642; the reach table also lists tests/finite_boundary.py): no assertion that a summary() row of a bucket with duty_counts == 0 carries no duty/events/duty_samples keys

finding.title: No check pins that an inferred-only defrost bucket's summary row omits the measured-duty block
finding.claim: Mutant 24d9995ccee4252e (defrost.py:642, duty_counts > 0 -> >= 0) survives the full gate (RED-AS-NULL), yet DefrostDerate.summary() on a learner with one inferred observation and no counted duty gains a duty=0.0 events=0 duty_samples=0 block on its row (rows_with_duty 0 -> 1).
finding.metric_definition: rows of DefrostDerate.summary() carrying a 'duty' key on a learner whose only evidence is one inferred observation (duty_counts all 0)
finding.phenomenon_property: A defrost bucket row in the diagnostics 'defrost_buckets' carries a measured-duty block only when that bucket has counted at least one duty sample
